description: Figure 3 is a four-panel composite that mixes bright-field TEM micrographs with EDS spectra. (a) is a TEM micrograph of the as-cast 0.02Nb steel (black boxed label "0.02Nb", 500 nm scale bar) showing one submicron particle, arrowed in red and labelled "Spot 1", embedded in a matrix labelled γ (yellow); the caption calls these "submicron white particles" though the arrowed particle appears dark. Its top-right inset is an SAED pattern with red-indexed fcc reflections (002, 0-22, 0-20) and yellow-indexed reflections (011, 0-11), annotated [100]γ // [100]NbC. (b) is the matching micrograph of the as-cast 0.04Nb steel (500 nm scale bar) with a "Spot 2" particle and an SAED inset carrying the same [100]γ // [100]NbC indexing. (c) and (d) are EDS spectra of Spot 1 and Spot 2 (cps/eV versus keV, 0-20 keV); both are dominated by a tall Nb peak near 2 keV, peaking between the 20 and 25 cps/eV gridlines in (c) and between the 15 and 20 cps/eV gridlines in (d), with minor C, O, Al, Si, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Cu and a second Nb peak near 17 keV. Together the panels identify the particles as NbC in both steels. Note: the citing text refers to EBSD grain-boundary maps for Figure 3b,d, which the supplied panels do not show.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a bright-field TEM micrograph of the as-cast 0.02Nb steel (boxed label "0.02Nb") with a 500 nm scale bar, showing a single submicron particle arrowed in red and labelled "Spot 1" inside a matrix marked γ.

Panel (b) is the corresponding bright-field TEM micrograph of the as-cast 0.04Nb steel (boxed label "0.04Nb", 500 nm scale bar) with a particle arrowed and labelled "Spot 2" at a grain boundary in a matrix marked γ.

Both SAED insets (in (a) and (b)) carry the same annotation [100]γ // [100]NbC, with red-indexed reflections (0-22, 002, 0-20) and yellow-indexed reflections (0-11, 011), indicating a cube-on-cube orientation relationship between austenite and NbC.
The EDS spectrum of Spot 1 (c) is plotted as cps/eV versus keV (0-20) and is dominated by an Nb peak near 2 keV that rises between the 20 and 25 cps/eV gridlines, with a second Nb peak near 17 keV.
The EDS spectrum of Spot 2 (d) is plotted as cps/eV versus keV (0-20) with the Nb peak near 2 keV reaching between the 15 and 20 cps/eV gridlines, i.e. lower than the Nb peak of Spot 1.
Besides Nb, both EDS spectra contain labelled peaks for C, O, Al, Si, Cr, Fe, Mn, Co and Cu; the Fe and Cr peaks are the largest of these solutes.
The arrowed particles in the TEM micrographs appear dark against the matrix, whereas the caption describes them as "submicron white particles" — the image does not confirm the "white" description.

The caption states that the EDS analysis in (c) and (d) is from Spot 1 in (a) and Spot 2 in (b), respectively, and that the panels show TEM analysis of submicron white particles in the as-cast 0.02Nb and 0.04Nb steels.
The citing text states that the black lines in the EBSD maps are grain boundaries identified by a minimum misorientation angle of 15° and were used to distinguish austenite grains.

The citing text reports an average austenite grain size of 18 μm in the as-cast 0.02Nb steel versus 9 μm in the as-cast 0.04Nb steel (Channel 5 software), and average ferrite grain sizes of 3.6 μm and 3.1 μm, respectively.

The citing text states that the austenite grain size remains almost unchanged after aging treatment at 823 K for 3 h, referring to "Figure 3b,d" — but the supplied Figure 3 panels are TEM micrographs and EDS spectra, not EBSD maps.

subfigures.description: Bright-field TEM micrograph of as-cast 0.02Nb steel, boxed label "0.02Nb", 500 nm scale bar. A single submicron particle (dark, arrowed, red "Spot 1") sits within a matrix labelled γ (yellow). Top-right inset: SAED pattern with red reflections 0-22, 002, 0-20 and yellow reflections 0-11, 011, annotated [100]γ // [100]NbC.

Bright-field TEM micrograph of as-cast 0.04Nb steel, boxed label "0.04Nb", 500 nm scale bar. A particle at a grain boundary is arrowed and labelled "Spot 2" (red); the matrix is labelled γ (yellow). Inset SAED pattern shows red 0-22, 002, 0-20 and yellow 0-11, 011 reflections with the annotation [100]γ // [100]NbC.

EDS spectrum of Spot 1: x-axis energy in keV (0-20), y-axis cps/eV (0-25). Dominant Nb peak near 2 keV rising between the 20 and 25 cps/eV gridlines, with labelled C, O, Al, Si, Cr, Fe, Mn, Co, Cu peaks at low energy and a second Nb peak near 17 keV.

EDS spectrum of Spot 2: x-axis energy in keV (0-20), y-axis cps/eV (0-20). Nb peak near 2 keV peaking between the 15 and 20 cps/eV gridlines, with labelled C, O, Al, Si, Cr, Fe, Mn, Co, Cu peaks and a second Nb peak near 17 keV.
